body.description: cmini's v3 detail JSON verbatim minus the record fields (name/user/likes/created_at/modified_at): board keys free? magic? combos? tag? blame? link?
The common format: cmini's keys map, #261's board geometry, an authoring shape for magic rules, a raw-rule escape hatch, and a free-form x. What akl.gg writes and most clients read.
A mana2 .jsonc layout object (layout.fingers/thumbs, board, fingermap, magic.rules) -- mana's own write format. Layers/combos are todo in mana2's own spec.
